data.title: 柴郡 · 冰雪仙子新春旗袍漫步
data.description: 【柴郡 · 冰雪仙子新春旗袍漫步】张灯结彩的重樱东煌庭院雪景中，红灯笼在白雪屋檐下摇曳。柴郡身穿冰蓝刺金的高叉丝绸旗袍，肩披雪白狐毛披肩，双腿裹在薄透白丝中亭亭玉立。她俏皮地单脚点地转身，高叉下白皙丰腴的腿根若隐若现，笑颜如春花般灿烂——「亲爱的快看！东煌的这套旗袍是不是显得柴郡更可爱了呢？」
data.location: 积雪覆檐的东煌水榭回廊
data.action: 身穿高叉旗袍单脚轻盈转身，手提毛绒暖手筒，发髻猫耳相映生辉
data.lighting: 红灯笼暖光与庭院白雪漫射的明丽冷暖交织
data.camera: full body, 3/4 dynamic angle, flowing fabric
data.promptProse: Cheshire turns lightly on one foot in the snow-covered ceremonial garden, smiling in an icy-cyan silk qipao with gold cloud embroidery, white fur trim and white stockings. The full-body three-quarter view keeps the flowing skirt beside red lanterns and snow-capped eaves behind. Warm lantern light colors the near sleeve and gold stitching, while bright reflected snow light cools the shaded fabric and defines her satin heels against the path.
